# @scramjet/obj-logger

Object-mode structured logger with pipeable stream output, log level control, multi-target support, and source aggregation.

## Install

```bash
npm install @scramjet/obj-logger
```

## Import

```typescript
import { /* ... */ } from "@scramjet/obj-logger";
```

## Documentation

See the [package docs](https://github.com/scramjetorg/transform-hub/tree/HEAD/packages/obj-logger) for full documentation.
